hub_group_models_mapping_check.name: hub_group_models_mapping_check
hub_group_models_mapping_check.value:
(
        ("hub_group_models"."model_id" IS NOT NULL AND "hub_group_models"."discovery_status" <> 'unmapped') OR
        (NOT "hub_group_models"."traffic_enabled" AND NOT "hub_group_models"."probe_enabled")
      )

hub_group_models_base_url_override_check.name: hub_group_models_base_url_override_check
hub_group_models_base_url_override_check.value:
(
        ("hub_group_models"."base_url_override_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "hub_group_models"."base_url_override_host_hash" IS NULL) OR
        ("hub_group_models"."base_url_override_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "hub_group_models"."base_url_override_host_hash" IS NOT NULL)
      )

hub_provider_groups_balance_check.name: hub_provider_groups_balance_check
hub_provider_groups_balance_check.value:
(
        ("hub_provider_groups"."last_balance_micros" IS NULL AND "hub_provider_groups"."balance_currency" IS NULL) OR
        ("hub_provider_groups"."last_balance_micros" >= 0 AND "hub_provider_groups"."balance_currency" IS NOT NULL)
      )

probe_targets_source_config_check.name: probe_targets_source_config_check
probe_targets_source_config_check.value:
(
        "probe_targets"."source" = 'legacy_radar' AND "probe_targets"."source_ref" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "probe_targets"."source" = 'native' AND
        "probe_targets"."endpoint_url" IS NOT NULL AND
        "probe_targets"."api_key_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND
        "probe_targets"."api_key_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND
        "probe_targets"."api_key_last_four" IS NOT NULL
      )
